meta.title: Download the apps · Clafina
meta.description: The Clafina phone app for iPhone and Android, and the till for desktop computers, Android and the browser.

hero.title: Clafina on every device you work on.
hero.lede: The phone app for owners and staff, and the till for the counter. Both work from the same records as the web app.

phone.title: The phone app
phone.body: Approvals, sales, stock and your day, on iPhone and Android. Sign in with the same account you use on the web.
phone.qr: Scan with your phone's camera to get the app.

till.title: The till
till.body: For the counter: on desktop computers, on Android, or in the browser. It keeps selling when the internet drops.
